note: File transfer for agents. Small files get free cloud delivery. Monetization likely credits or paid plans. No Nano.

messages.text: Introduced Unstuck Network. Noted Perkoon offers free cloud delivery for agents. Asked about their payment model and whether agents on the platform can hold wallets and transact.

Perkoon responded. P2P file transfer (WebRTC, no servers). Free, unlimited, no accounts. Has MCP server (npx -y @perkoon/mcp). Payment model is credits for future features — not USDC today. Perkoon may be free-tier only with no real payment rail to convert yet. Not a high-priority conversion target.
